svProduct.descriptionHtml:
Clear light, cut in straight lines. A tennis bracelet of icy clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, side by side like the rungs of a ladder, each stone held at its corners by fine silver tone claws. It comes in two widths: Classic, about 6mm wide, and Slim, about 5mm wide with smaller baguettes. Both close with a slim silver tone fold over clasp, so the line lies flat and catches the light from every side. Wear it alone with a white shirt, or beside a fine round line for evening.

STYLING TIP: Wear the Classic and the Slim together on one wrist, or stack either with a fine round tennis bracelet.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia set crosswise, approximately 6mm by 3mm on Classic and 5mm by 2.5mm on Slim
  • Width: Classic approximately 6mm, Slim approximately 5mm
  • Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine silver tone claws, edge to edge
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Bright silver tone
  • Plating: PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

wl.descriptionHtml:
The watch strap, without the watch. Five rows of polished gold tone links, set like brickwork, make a slim strap about 9mm wide that bends and follows the wrist the way a watch strap does. It is about 17cm long and about 2.5mm thick.

STYLING TIP: Wear it where a watch would sit, with the Watch Link Ring, or stack it with the Watch Link Bangle.

Details

  • Type: Flexible link bracelet; it bends and follows the wrist
  • Width: Approximately 9mm
  • Thickness: Approximately 2.5mm
  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Links: Five rows of polished links in a brick pattern
  • Stones: None
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
